title: PhotoDeg-Bench v1.0.0: an open, harmonized benchmark of visible-light polymer deconstruction conditions and outcomes
description:
Curated, source-linked records of visible-light photochemical polymer deconstruction experiments from the open-access literature (Europe PMC, OpenAlex): polymer, molar mass before and after, SEC calibration type, catalyst, wavelength, solvent, time and product slate. Harmonization rules written by the curator from SEC practice are published with the data, with a comparability tier per record. Every record was checked against its source by the curator.

Contents: benchmark table (CSV), codebook, harmonization rules, QA report, provenance log, code. Limitations: open-access literature only; conventional SEC values are relative unless converted or measured absolutely; light dose is not harmonized. See LIMITATIONS.md.
